## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

Ref:EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

- When deciding what equipment to use when working at height, the type of work and duration will generally determine the suitability of the equipment. The following hierarchy is to be used when providing a safe place of work:
- ·Edge protection with guard rails and toe boards
- General access scaffold
- Mobilescaffold towers
- Mobilc Elcvating Work Platform (MEWP)
- Man basket
- Fall protection systems
- Ladders
- Amethod statement is requiredforallwork atheight.
- Further information on the work at height hierarchy is shown the following paragraphs;

## 3.12.1. General Scaffolds

- Scaffolds are to be designed, erected, altered and dismantled by a competent person and supervisor and be designed and erected in accordance with BS 5975.
- Scaffolders are to adopt methods of work to prevent falls during erection and dismantling by using the advanced guard system. Where this is not practical, safety harnesses are to be worn to provide a means of fall arrest.
- All scaffolds are to be constructed on a stable foundation on level foundation and sat on base plates. They are to be properly braced with platforms being a minimum of 3 boards wide and securely tied or otherwise supported toprevent movement.All openings in the platform are tobe protected to prevent unintentional falls. Scaffold boards are to be sound and free from splitting, twists and knots.
- Scaffolds' are to have suitable stair or ladder access onto the working platform. In general the use of ladder access should be restricted to short term scaffolds, long term scaffolds are to be supplied with staircase access.
- System scaffolds are tobe erected in accordance with themanufacturer's instructions.Scaffold platforms aretobekept clean and tidy and arenot tobe overloaded.
- Scaffolds are to be inspected by a certified scaffold inspector:
- Before use
- After substantial alteration
- After any event likely to have affected its stability
- ·At regular interval not exceeding 7 days
- Scaff tags aretobefitted tothescaffold showing the date ofthelastinspection.Unsafescaffolds are to show a red scaff tag.
